scoring_justification: The hidden checker independently recomputes the electron-lattice interaction energy using the published lattice sum formula for each (element, lattice) combination, then compares the agent's CSV values to the recomputed gold. This is a genuine recompute (T1) because the quantity is derived from first principles in the checker, not pre-stored.

units.energy: dimensionless (units of Z^2 e^4 m / h^2)

outputs.description: Computed electron-lattice interaction energy per atom in dimensionless units Z^2 e^4 m / h^2 for bcc, fcc, and hcp lattices of H, He, C, Fe.

steps.description: Verify each of the 12 energy values are within 1e-5 relative tolerance of the recomputed lattice sum result.
